title: Nine Acres Behind the Hill
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：area　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 area 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 my grandfather walked the ① area behind the hill every Sunday and said he was measuring it with his feet. The ② area, meaning the ground and not the map, was nine acres and one pond; an area, he said, is the only thing that is bigger when you walk it than when you draw it. He had walked it for eleven years and still found a gate he did not know.

Every ③ area on his map had a name that nobody in the village used, and he said that was the difference between a map and a place. The ④ area of the field, nine acres, was written on a card in 1952 and never changed; an area, my father said, is the only fact about land that a piece of paper can hold. He said the card was the only honest thing in the house.

My mother said the whole ⑤ area had gone quiet by 1974, meaning the people and not the ground. The ⑥ area, meaning the subject and not the place, is the only word that means both a field and a question; an area, my grandmother said, is a piece of the world or a piece of a mind, and you cannot tell from the word which. She said that was why argument is endless.

By 1979 the ⑦ area had been fenced, nine posts and one gate, and the walking stopped. The ⑧ area he cared about most was the pond, which was nine feet across and never froze; an area, he said, is measured by what it will not give up. He said the pond had refused him for eleven winters and he respected it for that.

The ⑨ area I remember is the one behind the hill, which I have not walked since 1981. An ⑩ area, my grandfather said, is the only thing you can own without ever having seen all of it; every area, he said, is larger than the person who is measuring it. He said that was the argument for walking and against maps.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地区；区域（一片地方）
B. n. 地区（指实地、那片土地本身，与地图相对）
C. n. 区域（被围栏围起来的那片地）
E. n. 地区（指一带的居民；引申）
F. n. 领域；方面（主题、学科）
G. n. 区域（抽象总称；泛指）
H. n. 区域（指其中他最在乎的那一小块）

items.q: The area, meaning the ground and not the map
the whole area had gone quiet
The area, meaning the subject and not the place
The area he cared about most

answers.why: area 意为“地区、区域”，1967 年起祖父每个星期天都走山后那片地方，说他在用脚丈量它。
area 指“实地、那片土地本身”，与地图相对，那片地是九英亩加一口池塘。
area 意为“地区、区域”，他地图上每一片区域都有一个村里人从不用的名字。
area 意为“面积”，这块地的面积是九英亩，1952 年写在一张卡片上，再没改过。
area 引申为“一带的居民”，母亲说整个一带到 1974 年都安静下来了，指的是人而不是土地。
area 意为“领域、方面”，指主题而不是地方，它是唯一既指一片田野又指一个问题的词。
area 指被围栏围起来的那片地，到 1979 年那片区域围起来了，九根柱子一道门，散步也停了。
area 指其中他最在乎的那一小块，他最上心的是那口池塘，宽九英尺，从不结冰。
area 意为“地区、区域”，我记得的是山后那一片，1981 年之后我再没走过。
area 为抽象总称，泛指“区域这种东西”，祖父说区域是你唯一可以拥有却从未看全的东西。
